t_advice_summary_textbox.text: be aware of which colour gnome finds the most mushrooms and continue to select this colour until the mushrooms begin to reduce, then switch to other colours.

vb_textbox.text: Try to quickly work out which colours and shapes of gnomes result in the highest number of mushrooms. Continue to select whichever gnome is the most successful until the mushrooms begin to decrease. Once the numbers have changed the cycle will repeat and you have to figure out which gnomes have more mushrooms.
